title: Kitchen Range Exhaust or Cross-Ventilation
action: Run kitchen exhaust hood on high during frying, boiling, or sautéing; if no vented hood, open a non-street-facing window
preconditions: kitchen exhaust hood or exterior window present
avoidWhen: outdoor wildfire smoke entering through unsealed intake window
sourceRefs: WHO Guidelines for Indoor Air Quality: Selected Pollutants (2010)
U.S. EPA Indoor Air Quality: Cooking and Ventilation in Homes

title: Source Control for Incense and Scented Candles
action: Extinguish incense sticks and scented combustion candles; switch to electric flameless LED diffusers
sourceRefs: U.S. EPA Guide to Air Cleaners in the Home (2018)
California Air Resources Board (CARB): Indoor Air Pollution from Combustion

title: Portable True HEPA Air Filtration
action: Operate portable mechanical HEPA air cleaner on medium or high speed in the primary occupied room with windows and doors closed
sourceRefs: CARB Certified Air Cleaning Devices Regulations
U.S. EPA Residential Air Cleaners Guide

title: Natural Ventilation During Clean Afternoon Window
action: Open windows on opposite sides of the home for 20-30 minutes during the lowest ambient pollution window (early afternoon) to purge indoor CO2 and VOCs
preconditions: outdoor air quality is moderate or clean
avoidWhen: active outdoor agricultural burning or dust storms
sourceRefs: ASHRAE Standard 62.2: Ventilation and Acceptable Indoor Air Quality in Residential Buildings

title: Fragrance-Free Cleaning Source Control
action: Use unscented or microfiber cleaning methods and avoid aerosolized pine/citrus solvents that react with ozone to form secondary particulates
sourceRefs: U.S. EPA Safer Choice Standard for Household Cleaners
